func TestPortableExportRejectsHostLocalAuthoritativeLock(t *testing.T) {
	root := portableFixture(t)
	body := `lockfile_version = 2
[meta]
name = "team"
version = "1"
[[packages]]
module = "helper"
kind = "skill"
owner = "local"
repo = "helper"
url = "agentpack-local:helper"
commit = "local"
cache_key = "helper"
`
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "pack.lock"), []byte(body), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := ExportBundle(root, filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "bundle")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("host-local authoritative lock accepted")
	}
}
sources.internal/lockfile::TestLoadsRustV2Lockfi:
func TestLoadsRustV2LockfileSchema(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	raw := `lockfile_version = 2

[meta]
name = "real-project"
version = "0.0.1"

[config]
disabled_plugins = ["legacy"]

[[packages]]
module = "github.com/anthropics/skills/skills/frontend-design"
direct = true
kind = "skill"
url = "https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/frontend-design"
owner = "anthropics"
repo = "skills"
path = "skills/frontend-design"
commit = "0123456789012345678901234567890123456789"
cache_key = "0123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123"
name = ""
`
	path := filepath.Join(root, "pack.lock")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(raw), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	lock, err := LoadFromPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("load Rust v2 lockfile: %v", err)
	}
	if lock.LockfileVersion != 2 || len(lock.Packages) != 1 || lock.Config.DisabledPlugins[0] != "legacy" {
		t.Fatalf("decoded lockfile = %#v", lock)
	}
}
sources.internal/manifest::TestDependencyAppendP:
func TestDependencyAppendPreservesEveryUnrelatedByte(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	original := "# top comment
name  =  "proj" # spacing stays

[dependencies] # dependency note
# insertion anchor

[custom]
value = "untouched"
"
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "agentpack.toml"), []byte(original), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := AppendDependencyPin(root, "github.com/Acme/repo/Skill", "v1.2.3"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := "# top comment
name  =  "proj" # spacing stays

[dependencies] # dependency note
"github.com/Acme/repo/Skill" = "v1.2.3"
# insertion anchor

[custom]
value = "untouched"
"
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "agentpack.toml"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(raw) != want {
		t.Fatalf("manifest bytes changed outside insertion
--- got ---
%s--- want ---
%s", raw, want)
	}
}
sources.internal/manifest::TestMCPReplacementPre:
func TestMCPReplacementPreservesEveryUnrelatedByte(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	original := "name = "proj"

[mcp.servers]
# keep before
server = { command = "old" } # replaced
# keep after

[other]
odd   =   true # exact
"
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "agentpack.toml"), []byte(original), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	command := "new"
	if err := AddMCPServer(root, "server", mcp.Server{Command: &command}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := "name = "proj"

[mcp.servers]
# keep before
server = { command = "new" }
# keep after

[other]
odd   =   true # exact
"
	raw, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "agentpack.toml"))
	if string(raw) != want {
		t.Fatalf("manifest bytes changed outside replacement
--- got ---
%s--- want ---
%s", raw, want)
	}
}
